subject_description: a TV home shopping host shown from the chest up, black suit, white shirt, dark red tie, white made-up face, large black eyes, tiny clip-on microphone on the lapel
initial_pose: facing the camera, both hands raised in front of the chest with the fingertips touching, closed-lip smile
description: laughs out loud like a jolly salesman: the head tilts back, the mouth opens wide and closes again and again with laughter; the touching fingertips tap together again and again; then settles back into the starting pose The shoulders stay almost still and never move sideways; the whole body and both hands stay inside the frame.
